product_name: Motorola Voice Cordless Phone System w/ 3 Digital Handsets + Answering Machine, Remote Access, Call Block - Dark Grey (T613)
description: Work or Home Phone - T613 is a dark grey cordless phone system with built in answering machine ideal for both office spaces and home use Hands-Free Conversations - Cordless phone combo features hands-free speakerphone so you can take calls without a handset and multi-task while in meetings or talking with friends Multiple Contact Phonebook - Telephone system holds up to 100 entries and includes convenient built-in answering machine to take messages when you're unavailable Bright Lighted Display - Phone features caller ID, advanced call blocking to keep unwanted calls away, and easy-to-read backlit displays Includes - Three (3) cordless handsets with base, six (6) rechargeable batteries, three (3) power adapters, setup guide
